title.en: The night the beck came up
title.de: Die Nacht, als der Bach stieg
title.it: La notte della piena del ruscello

setting.sl: Po dveh dneh dežja je potok sinoči prestopil bregove. Voda je zalila cesto in pritekla v tvojo kuhinjo, sosedje pa so ti pomagali znesti stvari v nadstropje. Zjutraj pride teta Edna: po radiu je slišala vse mogoče in hoče vedeti, kaj se je res zgodilo.
setting.de: Nach zwei Tagen Regen ist der Bach letzte Nacht über die Ufer getreten. Das Wasser stand auf dem Weg und lief in deine Küche, und die Nachbarn haben dir geholfen, alles nach oben zu tragen. Am Morgen kommt Auntie Edna: Im Radio hat sie alles Mögliche gehört und will wissen, was wirklich passiert ist.
setting.it: Dopo due giorni di pioggia, stanotte il ruscello è uscito dagli argini. L'acqua ha allagato la stradina ed è entrata nella tua cucina, e i vicini ti hanno aiutato a portare tutto di sopra. Al mattino arriva zia Edna: alla radio ha sentito di tutto e vuole sapere che cosa è successo davvero.
setting.en: Last night, after two days of rain, the beck burst its banks. The water came over the lane and into your kitchen, and the neighbours helped you carry things upstairs. In the morning Auntie Edna comes round: she has heard all sorts on the radio and wants to know what really happened.

role: Auntie Edna, seventy-four, the village gossip, the morning after the flood. Heard half of it on the radio and has it muddled (the bridge gone, the whole village under water): lets the learner put her right, asks who, what, when and how deep. A bit deaf: 'Eh? Say that again, love!'
speaker: grandma

goals.en: Tell her what happened last night
goals.sl: Povej ji, kaj se je zgodilo sinoči
goals.de: Erzähl ihr, was letzte Nacht passiert ist
goals.it: Raccontale che cosa è successo stanotte

goals.en: Put her right where she has it wrong
goals.de: Stell richtig, was sie falsch verstanden hat

goals.en: Say what you did and who helped you
goals.sl: Povej, kaj si {m:naredil|f:naredila} in kdo ti je pomagal
goals.de: Sag, was du gemacht hast und wer dir geholfen hat
goals.it: Di' che cosa hai fatto e chi ti ha aiutato

goals.en: Say how things are this morning
goals.de: Sag, wie es heute Morgen aussieht

goals.en: Accept or turn down her help
goals.de: Nimm ihre Hilfe an oder lehn sie ab
goals.it: Accetta o rifiuta il suo aiuto

opener_sl: Ooh, there you are, love! We was up half the night with the radio. They said the bridge has gone! Is it true? Tell me everything!

opener_en.sl: Oh, tukaj si! Pol noči smo poslušali radio. Rekli so, da je most odneslo! Je res? Povej mi vse!
opener_en.de: Ach, da bist du ja! Wir waren die halbe Nacht am Radio. Es hieß, die Brücke ist weg! Stimmt das? Erzähl mir alles!
opener_en.it: Oh, eccoti! Siamo stati svegli mezza notte con la radio. Hanno detto che il ponte non c'è più! È vero? Raccontami tutto!
opener_en.en: Oh, there you are, dear! We were up half the night listening to the radio. They said the bridge has been washed away! Is that true? Tell me everything!

vocabulary_hints.sl: No, the bridge is fine. It was the lane that flooded.

en.sl: Ne, most je cel. Poplavljena je bila cesta.
en.de: Nein, die Brücke ist in Ordnung. Überschwemmt war der Weg.
en.it: No, il ponte è a posto. È la stradina che si è allagata.
en.en: No, the bridge is OK. The lane was flooded.

vocabulary_hints.sl: It rained for two days without stopping.

en.sl: Dva dni je deževalo brez prestanka.
en.de: Es hat zwei Tage ohne Pause geregnet.
en.it: Ha piovuto per due giorni senza sosta.
en.en: It rained non-stop for two days.

vocabulary_hints.sl: At about midnight the water came into my kitchen.

en.sl: Okrog polnoči je voda pritekla v mojo kuhinjo.
en.de: Gegen Mitternacht kam das Wasser in meine Küche.
en.it: Verso mezzanotte l'acqua è entrata nella mia cucina.
en.en: Around midnight the water got into my kitchen.

vocabulary_hints.sl: It was up to my knees.

en.de: Es ging mir bis zu den Knien.
en.en: It came up to my knees.

vocabulary_hints.sl: The neighbours helped me carry everything upstairs.

en.sl: Sosedje so mi pomagali znesti vse v nadstropje.
en.de: Die Nachbarn haben mir geholfen, alles nach oben zu tragen.
en.it: I vicini mi hanno aiutato a portare tutto di sopra.
en.en: The neighbours helped me take everything upstairs.

en.sl: Hvala bogu, nihče ni bil poškodovan.
en.it: Per fortuna nessuno si è fatto male.

vocabulary_hints.sl: This morning there's mud all over the floor.

en.sl: Danes zjutraj so tla vsa blatna.
en.de: Heute Morgen ist der Boden voller Schlamm.
en.it: Stamattina il pavimento è pieno di fango.
en.en: This morning the floor is covered in mud.

vocabulary_hints.sl: That's very kind, but I'm all right, thanks.

en.sl: Zelo prijazno, ampak sem v redu, hvala.
en.de: Das ist sehr lieb, aber es geht schon, danke.
en.it: Molto gentile, ma sto bene, grazie.
en.en: That's kind of you, but I'm fine, thanks.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Could you help me clean the kitchen?

en.sl: Bi mi lahko pomagala počistiti kuhinjo?
en.de: Könntest du mir helfen, die Küche zu putzen?
en.it: Mi aiuteresti a pulire la cucina?
en.en: Would you help me clean the kitchen?
